name: mage
_comment: Caster. Long hair under a blue pointed wizard hat, a long-sleeved gown over dark navy trousers and black shoes. The modern robe proper (torso/clothes/robe) ships only a handful of poses, so the mage wears a full-coverage long-sleeve top instead — battle-ready in every pose, hat included. Built on the male base, which the generator draws the widest pose set for. Assemble bases are relative to the charset 'remote'.
